title: Security & Hosting Screening - Spectral Holdings
meeting_header:
Date: 2026-08-27
Start: 15:00 UTC
Duration: 47 minutes
Attendees: Samira Patel (Redwood AE), Ethan Chow (Redwood SE), Nadia Ruiz (Redwood SE); Liam O'Connor (CISO, Spectral), Priya Shah (Platform Eng), Marta Lopez (Compliance), Infra lead (unnamed)
summary: Intro + discovery on security posture and hosting preferences. Customer evaluating hosted vs dedicated vs private for regulatory and latency reasons. Key items: SOC2/ISO evidence, SSO/SAML integration, RBAC scoping, audit log retention and access, KMS/customer-managed keys (CMK), data residency and retention windows. Agreed next: share SOC2 report, architecture doc, schedule technical deep dive for network/VPC, and run a short benchmark on dedicated profile.
topics: SOC2/ISO evidence; SSO/SAML and IdP options; RBAC and least-privilege roles; audit logs & retention; encryption at-rest and in-transit, KMS/CMK; multi-tenant isolation vs dedicated pools; on-prem/private deployment constraints; support SLA and escalation paths.
transcript:
00:00 Samira: Hey everyone, thanks for making time. Quick intros?
00:07 Liam (Spectral): Liam here, I'm the CISO, Priya is my platform lead, Marta handles compliance, and we have our infra lead on.
00:15 Priya: Hi, yeah thanks.
00:17 Ethan: Ethan from Redwood, I'll be the technical lead on this call, Nadia and Samira here from AE/SE.
00:25 Marta: Good to meet you.
00:30 Samira: Main goal — understand your security and hosting constraints so we can recommend Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Open to high level first then dive deep.
00:44 Liam: Perfect. We're a financial data aggregator, regs matter, so SOC two, ISO27001 proof is baseline. Also we need SSO, SAML based SSO with our IdP and RBAC aligned to our internal roles.
01:01 Samira: Understood. We have SOC2 Type II and ISO attestation for the platform — I'll share redacted reports. Note: for Private deployments we can support customer-managed KMS, on-prem packages.
01:15 Priya: When you say "redacted reports" are we getting full controls matrices? Our auditors want specifics around change control and access reviews.
01:23 Samira: Typically we provide SOC2 report and a controls matrix; for enterprise deals we can share more detailed evidence under NDA.
01:35 Marta: Good. Also logging — we need immutable audit logs, 7 years retention for certain logs, ability to export to our SIEM.
01:46 Ethan: We support structured audit logs and long-term retention via our dedicated/offline export. For hosted, logs are retained per plan, but we can set up continuous export to your S3 or Splunk with encryption.
02:02 Priya: Continuous export — is that real-time or batched? Any guarantees on order/timestamps? Our compliance team wants deterministic ordering.
02:11 Ethan: It's near-real-time, typical 30s-2m batching on high throughput. There are sequence IDs in each event; ordering is preserved per api key/stream but not globally when cross-sharded — small caveat.
02:26 Priya: Hmm that cross-shard caveat could be sticky for ledger reconciliation. If ordering is not guaranteed globally, we'd rather run a private/dedicated where we control shard topology?
02:37 Samira: Right — dedicated pools reduce cross-tenant sharding and give you more determinism. Private on-prem gives the most control but is heavier ops.
02:48 Liam: Encryption — we need customer-managed keys with HSM-backed KMS. Hosted offering supports CMK?
02:55 Samira: Hosted supports envelope encryption with vendor-managed keys by default; we offer CMK via our enterprise plan — can integrate with AWS KMS or a bring-your-own-key HSM solution for dedicated/private.
03:09 Marta: Does that include model artifacts and cached KV entries? We cannot have plaintext persistence.
03:15 Ethan: Yes, both models and KV cache at rest can be encrypted. For hosted, model weights are stored encrypted but keys are managed; for CMK we can wrap keys so you control master key rotation. Note: model caching layers have additional ephemeral caches on GPU nodes that are memory-only, but any disk spill is encrypted.
03:34 Priya: SSO/SAML — do you support SCIM for provisioning and SAML2.0? Our SCIM needs to automate group-sync to map RBAC roles.
03:42 Samira: Yes SAML2.0 and SCIM supported. Group mappings can be synced; we have role templates but they can be customized.
03:51 Priya: What's the lowest-privilege role pattern you recommend for Platform Engineers vs App Developers?
03:58 Ethan: Typical pattern: platform ops get deploy+monitor, app devs get inference keys limited to model calls. Admins get org-level RBAC. We can show default role JSON in the deep-dive.
04:11 Liam: Auditability — can we see token-level usage, per-request payload hashes for tamper evidence?
04:19 Ethan: We log token-level metrics (cost, latency) and request metadata. We can log a content hash. Note we do not store PII by default in logs; you can opt-into full payload logging if compliant with data policies.
04:34 Marta: Data retention policy — our legal requires certain PII be deleted within 30 days, and other logs kept 7 years. Is per-field retention configurable?
04:44 Samira: Hosted default is 90 days general; enterprise can set retention policies (30/90/365) and we also support on-demand purge APIs. Field-level retention is more complex; we can set redaction pipelines and tokenization upstream or route via private deployment.
05:03 Priya: If we need per-field redaction we probably need to host private or put a proxy in front to scrub.
05:10 Samira: Correct, private or dedicated with proxy yields most flexibility.
05:14 Infra Lead: Network — VPC peering, private link options? Our infra requires no public egress for certain envs.
05:22 Ethan: Dedicated supports VPC peering and PrivateLink; Private/On-prem eliminates public paths. Hosted has private connectivity via PrivateLink in supported regions.
05:34 Priya: SLA and incident response — do you provide SOC incident detail and forensics access?
05:40 Samira: We have 24/7 support for enterprise, runbooks, and can provide incident timelines. For private deployments, you have direct control. For hosted incidents, we provide post-incident reports and root cause analyses.
05:55 Marta: Compliance evidence — will you provide pen test summaries and vuln scan results?
06:01 Samira: Yes, redacted pen-test summaries and vulnerability scan attestations are available.
06:08 Liam: Are you ISO certified?
06:10 Samira: We hold ISO27001 in addition to SOC2.
06:14 Liam: Great.
06:16 Priya: Performance — if we go dedicated, what's the uplift for latency and throughput for our use-case (averaging 60 req/s, 512 tokens)?
06:26 Ethan: Roughly 20-40% latency improvement due to isolated batching and no noisy neighbors; throughput scales linearly with reserved GPUs. We'll run a micro-benchmark under a dedicated profile.
06:38 Priya: Cost tradeoffs?
06:41 Samira: Dedicated has a commit model; unit token cost drops but with monthly reserve. Hosted is pay-as-you-go but costs more at scale. Private adds one-time deployment and support fees.
06:52 Liam: Risk questions — how do you handle third-party subprocesses? Any data sent to external APIs?
06:58 Ethan: Platform does not call external inference APIs from customer requests. Telemetry and telemetry endpoints are internal; any third-party integrations are customer-configured.
07:12 Marta: About RBAC auditing — we need proof that access reviews happen quarterly. Is that automated?
07:18 Samira: We have an admin audit log and can surface access-change reports. Automated reminders for access review are part of the console for enterprise customers.
07:30 Priya: Encryption in transit — TLS 1.2+? Mutual TLS for private connectors?
07:36 Ethan: TLS 1.3 preferred, 1.2 supported. Mutual TLS for private link and on-prem agents supported.
07:45 Priya: Anything about federated audit logs across regions? We have cross-region compliance.
07:52 Samira: We can aggregate logs to your central S3 or SIEM; region residency controlled by deployment choice. Hosted has region controls for data residency on enterprise contracts.
08:05 Liam: For our internal auditors, they'd like to review the incident playbook and run a tabletop. Is that possible?
08:12 Samira: Yes, we can coordinate a tabletop with our security org; we'll include the SEs.
08:18 Marta: On data deletion — is there a way to provide certs of deletion?
08:22 Ethan: We can provide deletion receipts and audit entries showing purge events. For hosted, a deletion API triggers backend erasure and we log the operation. For private, you'd get direct access.
08:35 Priya: Any constraints for model fine-tuning with our data? We need to ensure no persistent training unless explicitly opted in.
08:43 Samira: By default, hosted models are not used to train public models. We can enforce no-tuning flags and isolated model instances for you.
08:54 Liam: Ok, next steps? I'd like the SOC2 and ISO docs, the network/VPC architecture, and an action item to run the dedicated benchmark.
09:03 Samira: We'll send SOC2/ISO artifacts (redacted), architecture doc, and propose a date for the benchmark deep-dive.
09:10 Nadia: For the benchmark we'll need sample queries, token lengths, and expected concurrency; Priya can upload to our secure test bucket.
09:18 Priya: We'll prepare that.
09:20 Marta: Also send the pen test summary and the data retention purge API spec.
09:24 Samira: Will do.
09:26 Unidentified Speaker: Quick Q on SAML attributes — can we pass custom claims?
09:30 Ethan: Yes custom attributes supported; we map to role claims or groups. Some IdPs require mapping rules, we have examples for Okta and Azure AD.
09:42 Priya: Any default role that allows read-only access to logs for auditors?
09:47 Ethan: There's an auditor role that is read-only with log access; we can scope to redact payloads.
09:55 Liam: Good. Thanks all — we'll review internally and come back with an NDA for additional evidence if needed.
10:02 Samira: Thanks, we'll follow up with artifacts and a proposed date.
10:06 Marta: thanks bye
10:08 [call ends]

Samira Patel: Provide architecture diagram showing VPC/PrivateLink and log export flow (due 2026-08-31)

Schedule technical deep-dive for network/VPC and PrivateLink (SE-led)
Run dedicated micro-benchmark using Spectral sample workload
Exchange NDA to share more detailed evidence if requested
Confirm retention and purge API details for legal review
